_comment: Refs of huntridge-labs/argus this suite can be pointed at.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A reusable-workflow `uses:` reference cannot be an
expression -- GitHub resolves it when the workflow is parsed, before any
is not expressible, and a dispatch target has to name every ref it can run
as a literal, one job per ref, selected by `if:`.
That makes the enumeration the contract. This file is the single place it
is written down; the four dispatch targets mirror it, and I4 fails if they
drift. Adding a ref means editing this file AND adding a job to each target
The alternative -- defaulting an unrecognised ref to main -- is the exact
failure this suite exists to catch: a run that reports a ref it did not
test. argus-scan and argus-dispatch refuse to dispatch an unlisted ref, and
each target carries a guard job that fails for the same reason.

refs.note: Default branch. What a consumer pinning @main gets today. Carries argus PR #427 (validate-inputs, nine workflow_call outputs, search_paths/platform/fail_on_no_targets, the argus_scan_incomplete sentinel) since it merged on 2026-09-22 as 99c0166. The N-series and D5 were written as expected-red against that PR's branch; against main they are the evaluation of whether the fixes held in what shipped.
